title: Check for multiple imports on one line.
summary: According to PEP 8, "imports should usually be on separate lines." Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle and made it stable in v0.0.191.

title: Checks for imports that are not at the top of the file.
summary: According to PEP 8, "imports are always put at the top of the file, just after any module comments and docstrings, and before module globals and constants." Ruff takes this rule from pycodestyle and made it stable in v0.0.28.
message_templates: Module level import not at top of cell
Module level import not at top of file

title: Iterated dict '…' is being modified inside for loop body, iterate through a copy of it instead.
summary: Emitted when items are added or removed to a dict being iterated through. Doing so raises a RuntimeError. pylint calls it modified-iterating-dict.
message_templates: Iterated dict '{}' is being modified inside for loop body, iterate through a copy of it instead.

title: Iterated set '…' is being modified inside for loop body, iterate through a copy of it instead.
summary: Emitted when items are added or removed to a set being iterated through. Doing so raises a RuntimeError. pylint calls it modified-iterating-set.
message_templates: Iterated set '{}' is being modified inside for loop body, iterate through a copy of it instead.
